questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a part of Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Oceania includes Australasia, Melanesia, Micronesia, and Polynesia.
Incorrect. Melanesia is listed as part of Oceania in the article.
Incorrect. Micronesia is listed as part of Oceania in the article.
Incorrect. Polynesia is listed as part of Oceania in the article.

questions.question: What is the estimated land area of Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Oceania is estimated to have a land area of about 9,000,000 square kilometres.
Incorrect. 3,500,000 square miles is the equivalent in square miles, not the land area in square kilometres.
Incorrect. 46.3 million is the population estimate, not the land area.
Incorrect. 4,884 metres is the height of Puncak Jaya, not the land area.

questions.question: What is the estimated population of Oceania as of 2024?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Oceania has a population of around 46.3 million as of 2024.
Incorrect. 9 million is not the population; it is the land area in square kilometres.
Incorrect. 3.5 million is not the population; it is the land area in square miles.
Incorrect. 60,000 is not the population; it is a time period mentioned for the first settlers.

questions.question: Which country is the largest and most populous in Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the largest and most populous country in Oceania is Australia.
Incorrect. New Zealand is not described as the largest and most populous country in Oceania.
Incorrect. Papua New Guinea is not described as the largest and most populous country in Oceania.
Incorrect. Indonesia is not described as the largest and most populous country in Oceania; Puncak Jaya is in Indonesia.

questions.question: What is the largest city in Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the largest city is Sydney.
Incorrect. Melbourne is not mentioned as the largest city.
Incorrect. Auckland is not mentioned as the largest city.
Incorrect. Honolulu is not mentioned as the largest city.

questions.question: What is the highest peak in Oceania and where is it located?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Puncak Jaya in Indonesia is the highest peak in Oceania at 4,884 m.
Incorrect. Mount Cook is not mentioned as the highest peak.
Incorrect. Mount Kosciuszko is not mentioned as the highest peak.
Incorrect. Mauna Kea is not mentioned as the highest peak.

questions.question: Which island is covered by much of Earth's third-largest remaining area of tropical rainforest?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the third-largest remaining area of tropical rainforest covers much of the island of New Guinea.
Incorrect. Australia is not mentioned as the location of this rainforest.
Incorrect. Tahiti is not mentioned as the location of this rainforest.
Incorrect. Hawaii is not mentioned as the location of this rainforest.

questions.question: Which hemispheres does Oceania span?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Oceania spans the Eastern and Western hemispheres.
Incorrect. Northern and Southern are not the hemispheres mentioned.
Incorrect. Eastern and Northern are not the hemispheres mentioned.
Incorrect. Western and Southern are not the hemispheres mentioned.

questions.question: Which of the following countries is listed as having a highly developed economy in Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article lists New Zealand among the highly developed economies in Oceania.
Incorrect. Kiribati is listed as a less developed economy.
Incorrect. Tuvalu is listed as a less developed economy.
Incorrect. Vanuatu is listed as a less developed economy.

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as a less developed economy in Oceania?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article lists Papua New Guinea among the much less developed economies.
Incorrect. Australia is listed as highly developed.
Incorrect. French Polynesia is listed as highly developed.
Incorrect. New Caledonia is listed as highly developed.
